messages:
ravi: Quick threadpost-launch prioritization ask. We're missing a crisp rule to decide fastpatch vs next minor. Proposing a 3-line rubric + 48h triage owner + tiny rollout checklist. Thoughts?

sofia: yes to rubric. please include a simple "customer-facing" flag. So many internal-only asks get pushed up. :eyes: 

maria: Suggestion: add "dev estimate" as a gate. If >3 dev-days and impact isn't P1/P2 high customers, schedule. Keeps fastpatches small.

otto: SRE input: default canary and auto-rollback thresholds are needed in the checklist. @sre-bot?

sre-bot: Recommend canary 10%/10m -> 50%/15m -> 100% if healthy. Auto-rollback on error rate >5% or latency >2x baseline. See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/patches

ravi: Draft rubric (v0.1):
```
- qualifies_for_fastpatch if: regression OR security OR (P2 AND >=3 paying customers affected AND no easy workaround)
- dev_estimate gate: if estimate >3d, schedule unless P1
- triage_owner timelines: owner must respond within 48h or escalate to PM lead
```

sofia: can we add a one-line comms step: ping sales/account team for any P2+ so they can prepare messaging?

maria: +1. Also require a quick smoke test checklist attached to the ticket before rollout.

ravi: Plan: I'll publish the one-pager in handbook and add slash template `/patch request <ISSUE>` with those fields. Who can own rota next week?

sofia: I can take next week.

otto: I'll sync with SRE on rollout checklist and update the runbook if needed.

ravi: Action items: ravi -> publish one-pager + slash template; otto -> SRE checklist; maria -> add dev_estimate field to ticket template; sofia -> rota next week. I'll post the draft in #product-docs today.

sofia: Sounds good. No blockers. :rocket:
